unit.why: A short memorate: at seudah shelishit the tsaddik told how his late father, R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotchov, appeared to him in a Sabbath-afternoon dream and explained a verse, with a named witness as chain of transmission. The content is mostly exegesis.

stories.start_quote: בס׳ שמועות טובות כתב בשמו הקדוש
stories.end_quote: שמע אלה הדברים מפיו הקדוש זיע״א
stories.summary_en: At the third Sabbath meal the tsaddik told his companions that his father, R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotchov, appeared to him in a Sabbath-afternoon dream and interpreted Judah's words to Tamar as God telling Knesset Israel to wait in exile until the redemption, read through acronyms.

quotes: כי בחלום נראה לו אביו הרה״ק רי״מ מזלאטשוב
tags.why: The father appears in a dream and teaches.

quotes: בעת סעודה שלישית כאשר ישב עם המסובין
tags.why: Both the dream and the telling take place on Shabbat.

quotes: בעת סעודה שלישית כאשר ישב עם המסובין אמר
